shots.caption: Kalgoorlie (657 km from Perth) dep. 7 00; Cook (W.S. time) arr. 1930, (C.S. time) dep. 2130; Port Augusta (2347 km) arr. 1035.
shots.quote: 'Indian-Pacific' does not stop at all places shown; times are approximate and may be used to indicate the position of the train.
shots.cited: The page is the eastbound Indian-Pacific timetable of November 1976. Kalgoorlie is at 657 km from Perth and departs at 7 00. Cook arrives at 1930 Western time and departs at 2130 Central time, with watches put forward 1 1/2 hours. Port Augusta is at 2347 km and arrives at 1035. The note at the foot says the train does not stop at all places shown and the times are approximate.
shots.why: Slide 7 lists this leaflet as a record of the line's length: 2,347 less 657 is 1,690 km. Slide 9 uses its times: 7 00 to 1035 the next day is 27 hours 35 minutes on the clock, and 26 hours 5 minutes with the 1 1/2 hour clock change taken out.

shots.caption: Port Augusta (1614 km from Sydney) dep. 1900; Cook (C.S. time) arr. 8 30, (W.S. time) dep. 7 35; Kalgoorlie (3304 km) arr. 1945. 3304 - 1614 = 1,690 km.
shots.cited: The page is the westbound Indian-Pacific timetable of November 1976. Port Augusta is at 1614 km from Sydney and departs at 1900. Cook arrives at 8 30 Central time and departs at 7 35 Western time, with watches put back 1 1/2 hours. Kalgoorlie is at 3304 km and arrives at 1945.
shots.why: Slide 7 lists the 1976 leaflet as a record of the line's length, and this page gives the same figure from the Sydney end: 3,304 less 1,614 is 1,690 km. Slide 9 uses its times: 1900 to 1945 the next day is 24 hours 45 minutes on the clock, and 26 hours 15 minutes with the 1 1/2 hours added back.
